text_en: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind:
text_cn: 上主由旋风中向约伯发言说：

text_en: “Who is this that darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
text_cn: 用无知的话，使我的计划模糊不明的是谁？

text_en: Gird up your loins like a man, I will question you, and you shall declare to me.
text_cn: 你要像勇士束好你的腰，我要问你，请指教我！

text_en: “Where were you when I laid the foundation of the earth? Tell me, if you have understanding.
text_cn: 我奠定大地的基础时，你在哪里？你若聪明，尽管说罢！

text_en: Who determined its measurements—surely you know! Or who stretched the line upon it?
text_cn: 你知道是谁制定了地的度量，是谁在地上拉了准绳？

text_en: On what were its bases sunk, or who laid its cornerstone
text_cn: 地的基础置在何处，是谁立了地的角石？

text_en: when the morning stars sang together and all the heavenly beings shouted for joy?
text_cn: 当时星辰一起歌咏，天主的众子同声欢呼！

text_en: “Or who shut in the sea with doors when it burst out from the womb? —
text_cn: 海水汹涌如出母胎时，是谁用门将海关闭？

text_en: when I made the clouds its garment, and thick darkness its swaddling band,
text_cn: 是我用云彩作海的衣裳，用浓雾作海的襁（qiǎng）褓（bǎo）。

text_en: and prescribed bounds for it, and set bars and doors,
text_cn: 是我给海划定了界限，设立了门和闩（shuān），

text_en: and said, ‘Thus far shall you come, and no farther, and here shall your proud waves be stopped’?
text_cn: 并下令说：“你到此为止，不得越过；你的狂潮到此为止。”

text_en: “Have you commanded the morning since your days began, and caused the dawn to know its place,
text_cn: 你有生之日，何尝给晨光出过命令，又何尝使曙光知道它之所在？

text_en: so that it might take hold of the skirts of the earth, and the wicked be shaken out of it?
text_cn: 何尝使光握紧大地四角，将恶人从那里抖出去？

text_en: It is changed like clay under the seal, and it is dyed like a garment.
text_cn: 曙光改变大地，如在胶泥上盖印；使万物出现，如着锦衣；

text_en: Light is withheld from the wicked, and their uplifted arm is broken.
text_cn: 撤去恶人的光明，折断高举的手。

text_en: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea, or walked in the recesses of the deep?
text_cn: 你曾否到过海的源流，走过深渊的底处？

text_en: Have the gates of death been revealed to you, or have you seen the gates of deep darkness?
text_cn: 死亡的门给你开启过吗？你见过死影之门吗？

text_en: Have you comprehended the expanse of the earth? Declare, if you know all this.
text_cn: 你知道大地的广阔吗？你若知道，请你说罢！

text_en: “Where is the way to the dwelling of light, and where is the place of darkness,
text_cn: 赴光明之所的路是哪一条，黑暗的住处在那里？

text_en: that you may take it to its territory and that you may discern the paths to its home?
text_cn: 你知道如何引导黑暗到自己的境地，领黑暗回到自己居所的道路上吗？

text_en: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
text_cn: 你总该知道，因为你那时已诞生了，而你的年岁已很高。

text_en: “Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,
text_cn: 你到过雪库，见过雹仓吗？

text_en: which I have reserved for the time of trouble, for the day of battle and war?
text_cn: 那是我为降灾之时，为战争之日所存放的。

text_en: What is the way to the place where the light is distributed, or where the east wind is scattered upon the earth?
text_cn: 云雾由哪条路散开，东风由哪条路吹往大地？

text_en: “Who has cut a channel for the torrents of rain, and a way for the thunderbolt,
text_cn: 谁为暴雨启开闸门，谁为雷电指示道路，

text_en: to bring rain on a land where no one lives, on the desert, which is empty of human life,
text_cn: 好使雨落在无人之境，降在无人的荒野，

text_en: to satisfy the waste and desolate land, and to make the ground put forth grass?
text_cn: 为润泽荒野干旱之地，好使原野中的绿草生长？

text_en: “Has the rain a father, or who has begotten the drops of dew?
text_cn: 雨有父亲吗？谁生了露珠？

text_en: From whose womb did the ice come forth, and who has given birth to the hoarfrost of heaven?
text_cn: 冰出自谁的胎？天上的霜是谁生的？

text_en: The waters become hard like stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
text_cn: 水怎样凝结如石？深渊的表面怎样固结？

text_en: “Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades, or loose the cords of Orion?
text_cn: 你岂能拴住昴（mǎo）宿（xiù）的纽结，解开参（shēn）星的绳索？

text_en: Can you lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season, or can you guide the Bear with its children?
text_cn: 你岂能使晨星按时升出，引导北斗和它的星群？

text_en: Do you know the ordinances of the heavens? Can you establish their rule on the earth?
text_cn: 你岂知道天体的定律，立定天律以管治大地？

text_en: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, so that a flood of waters may cover you?
text_cn: 你岂能使你的声音上达云霄，使雨水沛然降在你处？

text_en: Can you send forth lightnings, so that they may go and say to you, ‘Here we are’?
text_cn: 你能否一发令，闪电就发出，且向你说：“我们在这里！”

text_en: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts, or given understanding to the mind?
text_cn: 谁将聪明给与鹳（guàn）鸟，将智慧赋与雄鸡？

text_en: Who has the wisdom to number the clouds? Or who can tilt the waterskins of the heavens,
text_cn: 当土壤坚固，泥块凝结之时，

text_en: when the dust runs into a mass and the clods cling together?
text_cn: 谁能凭智力数清云彩，能倾倒天上的水囊？

text_en: “Can you hunt the prey for the lion, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
text_cn: 当狮子伏于洞穴，卧于丛林埋伏的时候，

text_en: when they crouch in their dens, or lie in wait in their covert?
text_cn: 你是否能为牝（pìn）狮猎取食物，满足幼狮的食欲？

text_en: Who provides for the raven its prey, when its young ones cry to God, and wander about for lack of food?
text_cn: 当雏（chú）鸦无食，往还飞翔，向天主哀鸣的时候，谁能为乌鸦备食？
